integrity: All finite exceptional-prime assertions are checked by the embedded standard-library script against the included CSV. Mathematical proof, not a log alone, supplies unrestricted coverage. No independent external validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Full classification specific to exponent 10; the independent Hasse–Weil theorem is invoked for large-prime uniformity; exact finite verification below 6000 is supplied. title: Complete prime-power modular Waring numbers for tenth powers
